title: Local storage and privacy
description: Understand what Quickque stores locally, which anonymous usage totals leave the device, and how licences and voice models are handled.
body:
# Local storage and privacy

Quickque is designed to keep scripts and voice work on the device. There is no Quickque cloud script library, cloud transcription service, or silent online fallback. Local-first is a boundary to understand, not a promise that every device or network is automatically safe.

## Anonymous app-use analytics

Quickque sends a small amount of anonymous usage metadata so we can understand which parts of the app are useful and improve reliability. We count app opens, successful script creation, whether a script is a presentation or performance, whether it was blank, a sample or a duplicate, use of Voice Follow or Scene Partner, and completed reader-session totals. Reader-session totals include active reading seconds and script word count so we can understand typical script duration and size.

The analytics request contains no account, email, licence key, purchase information, persistent device or installation identifier, script ID, script title, script text, character name, voice ID or voice name, audio, microphone recording, transcript, contact information or advertising identifier. It does not use analytics cookies and does not attempt to identify or follow a person across launches or devices.

The service immediately adds each request to daily aggregate counters and sums. It does not retain an individual event record or store the sender's IP address in the analytics database. Aggregate totals may be retained to compare product use over time. Because no user or device identifier is collected, the totals cannot be retrieved or deleted for a particular person. Analytics failures are ignored and never block local app use.

## What persists locally

1. The library envelope in local device storage includes live scripts, the active selection, Trash entries, custom order and sort mode.

2. Reader and appearance settings are stored separately from the library backup.

3. Successfully installed Flow and Chatterbox models are cached on the Mac and are not included in script backups. Chatterbox runtimes, models and related assets remain subject to their applicable Chatterbox, Resemble AI and third-party licence terms.

4. Generated rehearsal audio persists under the app's application-support storage until removed. Exported files remain user files after a subscription ends.

5. A paid licence stores its signed lease in macOS Keychain. Device identification uses a one-way hash of a stable Mac identifier; raw serial numbers, scripts, voices and microphone content are not sent to the licence service. A licence may be activated on no more than two devices.

## Microphone and local network

Local Flow captures the selected microphone only while listening. Audio and recognition events are processed in memory and are not saved as recordings or transcript logs.

Phone Remote exchanges minimal reader state and validated control commands over the local session. It does not serve script text, audio, transcripts, model files or library contents. Its local HTTP transport is unencrypted, so use it only on a trusted network.

## Payments, licensing and updates

Payment providers process checkout and billing information under their own privacy policies. Quickque receives the minimum purchase reference and plan information required to issue and administer a licence; card details are not stored by Quickque.

The packaged Mac app uses the Quickque licence service to activate and refresh signed offline leases. Raw licence keys are stored in macOS Keychain and the server stores only a one-way key hash. Licence records, activated device hashes and issued-lease audit records are server-authoritative.

The packaged Mac app will use Sparkle 2. Sparkle contacts the Quickque HTTPS appcast and GitHub Releases to check for and download signed updates. It does not transmit scripts, voices or microphone data. Sparkle updates remain disabled until a signed appcast and production verification key are configured.

## Safer use

- Export a full backup before changing storage, deleting a script or uninstalling the app.
- Grant microphone permission only when intentionally starting Voice Follow.
- Pair Phone Remote only on a trusted local network and stop the session when finished.
- Share a specific meeting window rather than the whole display if the overlay should remain private.
- Never disable Gatekeeper for an unknown app or update.

Read [Requirements and installation](/guide/requirements-installation/) for the current release status and [Licence information](/license) for plan terms.
